hatchet-admin performs administrative tasks for a Hatchet instance.

Usage:
  hatchet-admin [flags]
  hatchet-admin [command]

Available Commands:
  completion   Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help         Help about any command
  k8s          Commands used to setup a Hatchet instance on Kubernetes
  keyset       command for managing keysets.
  quickstart   Command used to setup a Hatchet instance
  seed         seed create initial data in the database.
  seed-cypress seed-cypress create initial data in the database for cypress.
  token        command for generating tokens.

Flags:
      --config string   The path the config folder.
  -h, --help            help for hatchet-admin
      --version         print version and exit.

Use "hatchet-admin [command] --help" for more information about a command.
